main_text.l: A. C. 1466 Borussia in Casimiri Regis Poloniæ clientelam sese tradidit, & divisa fuit in Regium & Cruciferorum, quæ A. C. 1525. in Ducatum conversa, & Alberto Marchioni Brandeburgensi, ultimo Ordinis Teutonici Magistro, tradita fuit, à cujus posteritate hodieq; possidetur.
Sic quoq; Livonia A. C. 1561. ad Polonos concessit, ac abrogato Crucciferorum ordine Gothardus Ketlerus Dux Curlandiæ ac Semigalliæ creatus fuit. Reliquam Livoniam Polonis eripuerunt Sveci.
Extinctis Jagellonidis Polonia exteros Reges habere cœpit.
A. C. 1573 Henricus Dux Andegavensis, Caroli IX Galliæ Regis frater,

page.notes: The right margin notes were read as "Livo-niam." beside Explicatio 2 and "(4) Regum mutatio." beside Canon I. The first note is split across the line by a hyphen. Italic display of the names "Gothardus Ketlerus" and "Henricus Dux Andegavensis" is uncertain; the gothic-style "Gothar" and "Henricus" letters are doubtful. The word "Crucciferorum" is a probable misprint for "Crucifer-orum" as printed. The text continues onto the next page with "ter," at the bottom of the page.
